request: Read-only identify existing service units to reuse for API-only Secret materialization boot, without dumping secrets.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
units=$(systemctl list-unit-files --no-legend --no-pager | awk 'tolower($1) ~ /astera|cloudflare|vault|gpg/ {print $1}' | tr '
' ',' || true)
refs=$(grep -RIlE 'secure_up.sh|gpg-core|CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN_FILE' /etc/systemd/system --include='*.service' --include='*.timer' 2>/dev/null | sed 's|.*/||' | tr '
' ',' || true)
body=$(printf 'GPG_RETIREMENT_SYSTEMD_AUDIT
units=%s
legacy_refs=%s
' "$units" "$refs")
gh api -X POST repos/G-ACE-inc/server-core/issues/10/comments -f body="$body" --jq '.html_url'

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: Vault main 3e0c06 applied Host healthy shared mount Issue10 comment6226260039. Discover existing boot hook to preserve restart reliability.
